fixtures.name: text
fixtures.notes: the simplest leaf; every frontend renders it

fixtures.name: text-muted
fixtures.notes: variant is semantic; each frontend picks its own muting

fixtures.name: heading
fixtures.notes: level is 1..4, not a tag name

fixtures.name: link
fixtures.notes: href is data; a native frontend opens a browser

fixtures.name: divider
fixtures.notes: no required fields; a lowering must handle the bare case

fixtures.name: divider-labelled
fixtures.notes: the 'or' separator both migrated apps use

fixtures.name: spacer
fixtures.notes: size is in theme spacing units, not pixels

fixtures.name: icon
fixtures.notes: named, not a glyph or a path; frontends own the artwork

fixtures.name: row
fixtures.notes: nesting; gap is a number, not a CSS string

fixtures.name: column-nested
fixtures.notes: recursion depth > 1, which is where lowerings drift

fixtures.name: panel-card
fixtures.notes: a titled container; the browser draws a header, Flutter a Card

fixtures.name: empty-column
fixtures.notes: a lowering must not crash on an empty container

fixtures.name: text-output
fixtures.notes: an empty slot; the value arrives later, tagged by kind

fixtures.name: text-output-heading
fixtures.notes: a caption whose text is computed: the output slot styled like text's heading variant, same tokens in both lowerings

fixtures.name: plot-output-responsive
fixtures.notes: no dimensions: the client reports its box via measure

fixtures.name: plot-output-fixed
fixtures.notes: explicit dimensions, which a native client needs

fixtures.name: plot-output-height-only
fixtures.notes: the timeline-strip shape: width tracks the container, height is declared

fixtures.name: audio-output
fixtures.notes: browser has a player element; Flutter needs a package outside the SDK

fixtures.name: video-output
fixtures.notes: the value's src is a URL on purpose: seeking byte-range-requests it

fixtures.name: video-output-config
fixtures.notes: autoplay rides muted, the one combination browsers allow

fixtures.name: text-input
fixtures.notes: emit defaults to live; browser debounces, Flutter uses onChanged

fixtures.name: select-input
fixtures.notes: choices normalize to value/label however they were written

fixtures.name: select-search
fixtures.notes: a combobox over the same closed choices: typing filters, only a real choice reports

fixtures.name: select-multiple
fixtures.notes: its value is a list at every length; a lowering that picks one control per component silently makes this pick-one

fixtures.name: slider-input
fixtures.notes: numbers, not CSS strings: Flutter derives Slider divisions from step

fixtures.name: range-slider
fixtures.notes: one input, two thumbs; its value is the pair [lo, hi] on the wire, both ends on the step grid

fixtures.name: button-primary
fixtures.notes: emits an event, not an input: there is no value to keep

fixtures.name: button-listing
fixtures.notes: one row of a list: start-aligned, body-coloured, quiet until hovered

fixtures.name: password-input
fixtures.notes: no value field exists, so no secret can reach the wire

fixtures.name: tabset
fixtures.notes: Flutter and the browser both retain hidden panel state

fixtures.name: conditional-panel
fixtures.notes: the condition is data, evaluated by whoever renders it

fixtures.name: page
fixtures.notes: the root every client is handed in welcome

fixtures.name: page-full
fixtures.notes: width is a viewport hint; the browser drops the reading column, native may ignore it

fixtures.name: workspace-fill
fixtures.notes: the workspace shape: stretched row, filled panel, a grown column that scrolls its overflow

fixtures.name: text-mono-small
fixtures.notes: mono aligns by character, small is fine print; both stay semantic

fixtures.name: textarea-input
fixtures.notes: rows is a count, not a CSS height

fixtures.name: textarea-clear-on
fixtures.notes: the composer: emitting the named event clears the field client-side, AFTER the event frame, so the handler reads the full draft

fixtures.name: number-input
fixtures.notes: bounds and step are numbers a frontend may spend on a spinner, a slider, or a hint

fixtures.name: checkbox-input
fixtures.notes: a checkbox starts at a real boolean, never NULL

fixtures.name: radio-buttons
fixtures.notes: one value for the group, from the selected member

fixtures.name: checkbox-group
fixtures.notes: one id, many boxes; the value is the checked members' values in choice order, an array at every length

fixtures.name: checkbox-group-empty
fixtures.notes: nothing selected is a real state: character(0) on the server, [] on the wire, never NULL

fixtures.name: date-input
fixtures.notes: a date is a YYYY-MM-DD string on the wire, not a class

fixtures.name: file-input
fixtures.notes: its value arrives over HTTP, not the socket

fixtures.name: download-button
fixtures.notes: a press asks for a transfer ticket, not an event: the press IS the download

fixtures.name: verbatim-output
fixtures.notes: same text kind as text_output; only the display differs

fixtures.name: table-output
fixtures.notes: structure on the wire (header + rows), never markup

fixtures.name: data-table
fixtures.notes: same table value, interactive shell: options ride as data attributes, length_menu always an array

fixtures.name: data-table-defaults
fixtures.notes: defaults spelled out on the wire, nothing implied

fixtures.name: image-output
fixtures.notes: an image the app supplies, unlike a plot it renders

fixtures.name: html-output
fixtures.notes: browser-only: the html kind has no widget equivalent

fixtures.name: ui-output
fixtures.notes: the slot render_ui() fills with a component tree

fixtures.name: raw_html
fixtures.notes: browser renders; every other frontend must refuse by name

fixtures.name: shortcut
fixtures.notes: renders nothing and takes no space; a bare key waits for focus to leave a text field

fixtures.name: shortcut-modified
fixtures.notes: modifiers are parsed once in R, never by a frontend; ctrl means cmd on a Mac

fixtures.name: shortcut-held
fixtures.notes: autorepeat reaches only a binding that asked for it; value rides along as a button's does

fixtures.name: image
fixtures.notes: a picture that is part of the UI, not an output a renderer produced

fixtures.name: collapse
fixtures.notes: details/summary in the browser, ExpansionTile in Flutter

fixtures.name: collapse-closed
fixtures.notes: open defaults FALSE; both lowerings start it folded

fixtures.name: link-wrapping
fixtures.notes: a link around a logo; value= and children= are alternatives, never both

fixtures.name: row-sized
fixtures.notes: a fixed sidebar beside a filling centre -- the shape both migrated apps are built on

fixtures.name: button-valued
fixtures.notes: the value rides on the event, so one handler serves a list of rows

fixtures.name: icon-play
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw play -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing

fixtures.name: icon-stop
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw stop -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing

fixtures.name: icon-rotate
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw rotate -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing

fixtures.name: icon-trash
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw trash -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing

fixtures.name: icon-microphone
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw microphone -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing

fixtures.name: icon-bookmark
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw bookmark -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing

fixtures.name: icon-download
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw download -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing

fixtures.name: icon-upload
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw upload -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing

fixtures.name: icon-folder
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw folder -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing

fixtures.name: icon-file
fixtures.notes: every frontend must draw file -- the name is in the closed set, so there is no falling back to nothing
